## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to design a cross‑platform GPU pipeline within RN, balancing perf and safety; checks bridge design, threading, and memory budgets.

## Key Concepts
- TurboModule/JSI bridge
- Dedicated native render thread
- Lock-free queues and double buffering
- Fabric synchronization and frame timing
- Memory management and backpressure strategies

## Code Example
```javascript
const chart = createChart({type:'line',w:320,h:200});
chart.updateData(points);
chart.setTheme({colors:['#4CAF50']});
chart.onFrame(({frameTime}) => trackFrame(frameTime));
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you tune backpressure for spikes to 1kHz?
- How would you handle device memory pressure when multiple charts render simultaneously?
